description:
A distant earthquake. A Nevada desert pool. The connection was beneath the surface.

Seismic energy moved the ground, making water already in Devils Hole oscillate—a seismic seiche. NPS reported about 10-inch waves and only a minor disturbance to the pupfish feeding shelf after the July 29, 2025 Kamchatka earthquake.

Illustrative reconstructions and original animations, not earthquake footage. AI-generated narration. July 30 monitoring still: NPS. No claim to original U.S. Government works. Map geometry: Natural Earth, public domain.
Sources: National Park Service, July 29, 2025 Devils Hole event report; USGS, Seismic Seiches.
https://home.nps.gov/deva/learn/news/devils-hole-2025-07-29.htm
https://www.usgs.gov/programs/earthquake-hazards/seismic-seiches

#Magnivis #DevilsHole #Earthquake #Seismology
firstComment:
The shallow shelf matters because Devils Hole pupfish feed and spawn there. For this event, NPS reported only a minor disturbance.
Sources: National Park Service, July 29, 2025 Devils Hole event report; USGS, Seismic Seiches.
